svg.aria-label: Calculation: after subtracting the blank current, plot steady-state current against voltage and take the slope of a straight line through the origin. Electronic conductivity equals L divided by A, times the slope; example about 5.0 times 10 to the minus 11 S/cm. Do not use points that curve upward at high voltage. The ionic transference number is close to 1.
